thread:
Lina: Heads up — drafting a short benchmark narrative for the webinar next Tue. Need a simple 3-chart story that ties latency -> user experience -> $/req. Anyone free to help line up visuals and copy? :eyes:

Raj: I can sketch charts. Thinking: 1) tail latency CDF, 2) cost per 1k tokens vs throughput, 3) throughput vs latency tradeoff (heatmap). Keep labels plain and audience-friendly.

Tess: For inbound routing, can we map CTA tiers to Dedicated vs Hosted? Quick rule proposal: >50 QPS -> dedicated lead sequence (AE/SE), 10-50 QPS -> sales-eng nurture, <10 QPS -> self-serve nurture.

Amber: Copy hooks: "Predictable latency, predictable cost" / "Latency budgets that don't bankrupt you". Also a short social lead: "How we make LLM inference predictable at scale — join our webinar."

Raj: mock chart config I'm thinking about:
```
chart1: CDF tail (p50,p90,p99) x=lat(ms) y=% requests
chart2: cost($)/1k tokens by model + quantization buckets
chart3: heatmap latency(ms) vs throughput(req/s) color=cost($/req)
```

Lina: love it. Can you produce PNGs by EOD? We need one hero image for social and one deep-dive figure for the webinar deck.

Raj: will start with synthetic curves, then overlay real metrics. pinging eng-runtime and @sandeep for kernel-level perf curves / KV-cache effects. @ops-bot please pull 7d perf data for model=redwood-1-small (sample sequences: 64/256/1024).

ops-bot: pulling perf data for redwood-1-small (7d) with seq=[64,256,1024]. ETA ~ 20m :gear:

Tess: Webinar flow idea: 5m quick product intro, 12m chart walk (narrative: tail matters -> cost levers -> how to pick model/quantization/routing), 10m demo (routing + rolling fallback), 15m Q&A + next steps. Slide mapping: archetype -> recommended CTA.

Amber: I'll draft 3 social caption variants and 2 hero image crop sizes. Need hero PNG by 2pm PST to hand to design.

Lina: if real PNGs are late we can whiteboard simplified charts as placeholders, but keep the messaging tight and the hero claim conservative. I'll assemble the deck skeleton after charts land. :thumbsup:
